landing.faq1A: Most platforms only handle lessons. SabakHub runs the whole center: live exams with anti-cheating, electronic attendance gradebooks, payments and finance tracking, and managing all your branches from one place.
landing.faq2Q: Are there limits on the number of students?
landing.faq2A: Limits depend on your selected plan. «Basic» is perfect for starting and small courses, «Professional» is built for medium-sized learning centers, and «Enterprise» is designed for large networks with no hard limits on student capacity.
landing.faq3Q: Which plans include the AI Manager and Test generation?
landing.faq3A: The full suite of Artificial Intelligence features (the 24/7 AI Assistant on your school page, automated exam question generation, and auto-grading of open answers) is exclusively included in the «Enterprise» plan.
landing.faq4A: Yes. Starting from the «Professional» plan, you can automatically generate and issue PDF certificates featuring a unique verification QR code and multi-language support. The certificates cannot be forged.
landing.faq5Q: Is my data and my students' data secure?
landing.faq5A: Security is built into every layer: strong encryption, separate access rights for each role, an admin action log, and complete data isolation for every center.

fpage.aiBotA: "The IELTS intensive lasts 2 months and costs 45,000 som. Mock tests included."
fpage.hwText: AI automatically checks students’ written work. It doesn’t just give a score — it detects plagiarism, highlights grammar mistakes and writes detailed feedback with advice for the student.
fpage.hwPoint: Fast feedback saves up to 15 hours a week.
fpage.genText: Upload a PDF or enter a topic, and AI instantly generates a set of questions with correct and wrong answers for a Kahoot-style quiz.
fpage.voiceText: Voice typing on any screen (profile notes, comments, chat). Tap the microphone icon and the neural network transcribes your voice with accurate commas and periods.
fpage.riskText: The Smart Dashboard analyzes attendance, class activity and homework completion. Students are automatically sorted on a risk board: "Red", "Yellow", "Green". Act proactively and save clients from churning before they take their money back!
fpage.journalText: Instant grading (A, B, C, F or 0-100) and attendance marking. Present, late, absent (excused/unexcused). Quick lesson comments are visible to students.
fpage.schedText: A lesson schedule builder. A visual class timetable with time and room conflict checks. Move lessons with a single click.
fpage.lmsText: Teachers upload materials straight into the course structure (documents, YouTube videos in the player, practical assignments). Students get everything in a logical sequence for self-study. No Google Drive and no cluttered Telegram chats.
fpage.streakText: Every visit keeps the "fire" of continuous learning burning. A missed class or skipped homework burns the streak. It motivates students to come back to class every day.
fpage.xpText: Submitting assignments on time earns experience points (XP). The levelling system moves students from the "Student" rank up to "Master", building a global competitive ladder (leaderboard).
fpage.quizText: Live tournaments in class! The teacher launches a quiz on the interactive whiteboard and students join from their phones. Leaderboard, timers and fun.
fpage.radarText: RPG-style progress charts. Students clearly see where they are weaker (e.g. grammar, listening) and can level up their target areas.
fpage.mobileText: The interface looks and behaves like a native app right in the smartphone’s Safari/Chrome browser. No need to download anything from app stores.
fpage.langText: The whole system is available in Russian, Kyrgyz, Uzbek and English. Each user can pick the language they are comfortable with, independently of others.
fpage.isoText: Your organization’s data is separated from other centers at the database level. Your client base is 100% private and protected by NoSQL keys.
fpage.branchText: Manage several locations across the city at once. Assign teachers, students and rooms to specific branches with separate financial reporting.
fpage.auditText: No edit to a grade or payment goes unnoticed. The system keeps a security audit trail (who changed what and when) to prevent staff fraud.
fpage.finText: Strict real-time billing: transaction aggregation, income/expense charts (today, week, month). The platform itself has a built-in automatic **Billing Guard**: smart deactivation of tenants’ SaaS modules when the Trial/Pro period ends, with real-time timers and API blocking at the backend level.
fpage.cheatText: Strict timed exams. Anti-cheating protection: the system records tab switches and blocks copy-paste.
fpage.certText: The platform creates and signs PDF certificates for graduates and assigns them QR codes for verification.
fpage.chatText: A built-in messenger for groups and teachers. File sharing, mentions, message history.
fpage.wlText: A customizable interface: set your own logo and organization colors so the platform looks like your own app.
fpage.jobsText: Publish partner job openings. Graduating students can apply with their résumé right from the school interface.
fpage.heroText: We designed 100% coverage of your school’s needs — from workflow automation to gamification, smart homework checking and billing. It’s more than an LMS. It’s SabakHub.

vibe.m1Intro: This is where understanding any web application begins. Before writing code, you need to see the two big parts every website or service is made of.
vibe.p1a: Everything the user sees and interacts with: pages, buttons, forms. It runs in the browser.
vibe.p1b: The hidden server side: logic, database, request handling. The user never sees it.
vibe.p1c: The frontend sends a request to the backend over the network, gets data back and shows it to the user.
vibe.m2Intro: The frontend of our platform (SabakHub) is written in React — the most popular library for building user interfaces. Understanding React means understanding how the visible part of the project works.
vibe.p2a: The interface is assembled from small reusable blocks — like pieces of a construction kit.
vibe.p2b: Data that makes the interface re-render automatically when it changes.
vibe.p2c: A huge ecosystem, community support — and it’s what this platform is built on.
vibe.m3Intro: Git is a version control system: it keeps the history of every code change. GitHub is a cloud service where repositories live and where a team works on them. For a vibecoder it’s insurance: any working state can be saved and restored.
vibe.p3a: commit — save a state, branches — parallel work, revert — go back.
vibe.p3b: Repository hosting, collaboration, pull requests for discussing changes.
vibe.p3c: Working version — commit it. Broke something — roll back. Without Git, vibecoding turns into roulette.
vibe.m4Intro: Our project has a backend too — but it’s built the modern way. It isn’t one big always-on server but separate functions that run “on demand”.
vibe.m4Body1: The whole platform is built on Node.js — an environment that runs JavaScript on the server instead of the browser. So the same language is used on both the frontend and the backend.
vibe.m4Body2: The frontend (React) is what the user sees. Our backend is a set of functions that run on Netlify (they’re called Netlify Functions).
vibe.m4Body3: Such functions are called serverless: you don’t need to set up or maintain a server. A function “wakes up” when a request arrives, does its job — for example, processes a payment or sends a notification — and “goes back to sleep”.
vibe.p4a: JavaScript on the server — all of the project’s server logic runs on it.
vibe.p4b: Our backend functions, triggered by requests from the frontend.
vibe.p4c: No need to keep a server running all the time — a function is called only when needed.
vibe.m5Intro: Modern apps hardly run “their own” servers — they use cloud services. The cloud is someone else’s servers (data centers) that you use over the internet without worrying about hardware, maintenance or updates.
vibe.m5Netlify: This is where our frontend is deployed and where the serverless functions (backend) run. Essentially, it’s the “home” of our whole app on the internet.
vibe.m5Firebase: Backend-as-a-service from Google. In our project it handles several things at once — the database, user sign-in and file storage.
vibe.p5a: Firebase’s cloud database, where all the platform’s data is stored.
vibe.p5b: User sign-in and sign-up — Firebase takes care of it.
vibe.learn1: Collaborative development, like in real IT projects.
vibe.learn2: The same tools the industry uses today.
vibe.learn3: Cloud services so others can use your website.
vibe.learn4: We build real products together with artificial intelligence.

vibe.lead: A step-by-step route: go through the stages in order — from how the web works at all to the infrastructure this platform runs on. Each stage is a short video or a breakdown of key concepts.

vibe.programText: We go all the way — from the first line of code to a finished website on the internet that real people can use. In a month, students build two complete projects with AI, after which they can take orders and build websites on their own.

vibe.choiceText: Students pick the second project themselves from a list of ideas provided by the teacher.
vibe.bothDone: Both projects are finished websites ready to show to clients.

greeting.title: Greeting
greeting.body: Hello! Thanks for contacting SabakHub support. I am looking into your question now.

inProgress.title: Taken in progress
inProgress.body: I have taken your request in progress. I am looking into it and will get back to you shortly.

needDetails.title: Need details
needDetails.body:
To look into this properly, could you tell me:
1. Which page does the problem occur on?
2. What were you doing just before it?
3. What happened instead of what you expected?

needScreenshot.title: Ask for a screenshot
needScreenshot.body: Could you send a screenshot or a short screen recording? That lets me see the problem through your eyes and answer faster. Use the paperclip button below to attach a file.

reproSteps.title: Steps to reproduce
reproSteps.body: Could you describe step by step what to do to make the error happen again? If it does not happen every time, let me know how often.

clearCache.title: Clear the cache
clearCache.body: Could you try reloading the page with a cache clear: Ctrl + F5 (Windows) or Cmd + Shift + R (Mac). That often clears the problem straight away.

tryAnotherBrowser.title: Try another browser
tryAnotherBrowser.body: Could you check whether the problem also happens in another browser or in a private window? That tells us whether it is a browser extension or the platform itself.

accessRights.title: Access rights
accessRights.body: This looks like an access-rights issue. Permissions are managed by the learning centre owner under “Team & roles” — ask them to open the section you need for your role.

planLimit.title: Plan limitation
planLimit.body: This feature is available on a higher plan. You can compare what each plan includes and switch under “Subscription” in the organization settings.

payment.title: Billing question
payment.body: For billing and invoices: the “Subscription” section in the organization settings shows your current plan, the next charge date and the payment history. If a payment has not shown up within an hour, write here and we will check it manually.

bugAccepted.title: Bug passed to the developers
bugAccepted.body: Confirmed — this is a bug on our side. I have passed it to the developers and will write here as soon as the fix ships. Thanks for reporting it!

featureRequest.title: Feature request noted
featureRequest.body: Thanks for the idea — I have added it to our feature-request list. We prioritise work by how many people ask for it, so your vote counts.

fixed.title: Fixed
fixed.body: The fix is live. Please reload the page (Ctrl + F5) and check — it should all work now. Let me know if anything is still off.

waitingReply.title: Waiting for your reply
waitingReply.body: I am waiting on your clarification to continue. If the question has already resolved itself, just say so and I will close the request.

closing.title: Closing the request
closing.body: Glad it is sorted! I am closing this request. If you need anything else, write in this same chat — the history is kept.

changes.p1: We may update this policy. We will announce material changes in the app or by email and show the update date at the top of the page.

contact.p1: For privacy questions: hello@sabakhub.kg, Telegram @sabakhub_bot, Osh, Kyrgyzstan.

cookies.heading: Cookies and storage
cookies.p1: We use cookies and browser local storage for authentication, remembering settings and basic usage analytics.
cookies.p2: You can clear storage in your browser settings, but some features (for example, sign-in) will stop working correctly.

data.heading: What data we collect
data.p1: Account data: name, email, role in the organization and, when signing in with Google, basic Google profile data.
data.p2: Learning data: courses, lessons, homework, exam results, attendance and grades that you create or upload to the platform.
data.p3: Technical data: IP address, device and browser type, and activity logs needed for security and diagnostics.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.p1: You can request access to your data, its correction or deletion.
rights.p2: The organization's administrator manages its users' learning data within the platform.
rights.p3: For personal data requests, write to us at hello@sabakhub.kg.

sharing.heading: Sharing with third parties
sharing.p1: We share data only with vetted contractors who help run the service (hosting, analytics, sending notifications), and only to the extent necessary.
sharing.p2: We may disclose data in response to a lawful request.

storage.heading: Storage and protection
storage.p1: Data is stored on Google Firebase infrastructure with encryption in transit and at rest.
storage.p2: Each organization's data is logically isolated; access is limited by the role model (RBAC) and security rules.
storage.p3: We keep data for as long as needed to run the service or as required by law.

use.heading: How we use data
use.p1: To provide and maintain the platform: sign-in, sync, notifications and analytics for your organization.
use.p2: To improve the product and keep it secure — detecting failures, abuse and suspicious activity.
use.p3: We do not sell your personal data and do not use the content of your courses for advertising.

acceptable.heading: Acceptable use
acceptable.p1: It is prohibited to upload illegal content, infringe others' rights, attempt to bypass security, or overload or hack the service.
acceptable.p2: It is prohibited to use the platform to send spam, malware or for unauthorized data collection.

acceptance.heading: Acceptance of terms
acceptance.p1: By using SabakHub, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.
acceptance.p2: If you use the service on behalf of an organization, you confirm that you are authorized to accept these terms for it.

accounts.heading: Accounts and access
accounts.p1: You are responsible for keeping your credentials safe and for actions taken under your account.
accounts.p2: Access to features depends on your role (administrator, manager, teacher, student) and your organization's plan.

billing.heading: Plans and payment
billing.p1: Paid plans are billed according to the selected plan. A trial period is provided on the terms stated in the app.
billing.p2: If payment is not made after the trial or paid period ends, access to paid modules may be restricted.
